patterns.what_worked: One production change (config_presets.lua) with the operator order recorded in the code as the gate, and 129 behavioural checks that pin the default, the AceDB merge for all ten class tokens, the toggle round-trip and the notice gate.
patterns.what_was_hard: Verifying the notices ride the same toggle needed the real practice_ui.lua loaded in a light sandbox - it loads cleanly with a stub guard + LSM, which was not obvious from the file's 7304 lines.
patterns.skill_gap: Reading the harness output during a parallel write (a transient third luacheck warning in tests/smoke.lua from the compat-f4 lane) required checking file mtimes before attributing the warning to my own change.
